meta.title: Soul Radar — reader-response analysis for DSH
meta.description: Reader-response analysis for DSH. It simulates a real reader's emotional reaction to a piece of writing and parses it into countable data with evidence: where interest lifts, where it drops, where the reader gets lost. It reports the parsed result and its basis; the DSH agent makes the final call and writes the feedback.

lt_score.name: Score a piece
lt_score.description: Read a piece the way a reader would, and return the reading data plus a report written for the calling agent.

lt_rules.name: List the criteria
lt_rules.description: Show every scoring criterion: what it measures, its status, and the evidence it rests on.

lt_demo.name: Run the built-in sample
lt_demo.description: Score the bundled sample article, so an agent can see what a report looks like without supplying a piece.
